title: How to find the cell address of a value
task: Get "$A$3"-style coordinates of where a value lives — for audits, debugging, or building references.
keywords: find cell address of value excel
cell reference of match google sheets

excel.note: MATCH finds the row; ADDRESS formats it. Column 1 = A.

explanation: MATCH returns the position of "cherry" (row 3) and ADDRESS turns a row/column pair into a reference string: "$A$3". ADDRESS's later arguments control the style — ADDRESS(3,1,4) gives relative "A3". The result is TEXT, not a live reference; to actually pull the value at a computed address, feed it to INDIRECT — though INDEX/MATCH does that more efficiently without the volatile INDIRECT.
